name: Utah Snowball Bash 2023

venue.name: [Salt Palace Convention Center](https://www.visitsaltlake.com/salt-palace-convention-center/)
venue.address: 90 South West Temple Salt Lake City, UT 84101

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahSnowballBash2023#33201-competitor-responsibilities) tab. 

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the [Registration and Waistlist Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahSnowballBash2023#33199-registration-and-waitlist-info) tab. 


Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
